name: @vibejs-org/cli
description: The vibejs command line: dev server, checks, generators, JSON output and an MCP server for coding agents.

scripts.build: tsdown && node ../../docs/scripts/docs.ts bundle dist/docs && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { projectAgentFiles, renderBlock, syncAgentFiles } from './src/agents.ts'; cpSync('../../skills', 'dist/skills', { recursive: true }); const { skills } = projectAgentFiles('.', 'dist'); const block = renderBlock('{{exec}}', readFileSync('dist/docs/index.txt', 'utf8').trim()); mkdirSync('dist/agents'); syncAgentFiles('dist/agents', { block, exec: '{{exec}}', skills }, true);"
